description: Test file for LinkMetadata functionality in the Mattermost project, including validation, deserialization, and image filtering related to link metadata and OpenGraph data.

methods.name: sampleImage
methods.description: Creates a sample image with specified name, returning an *image.Image with URL, SecureURL, Type, Width, and Height.

methods.name: TestLinkMetadataIsValid
methods.description: Tests the validation logic for LinkMetadata objects, including various valid and invalid cases.

methods.name: TestLinkMetadataDeserializeDataToConcreteType
methods.description: Tests deserialization of LinkMetadata.Data from JSON bytes or strings into concrete types like PostImage and OpenGraph.

methods.name: TestFloorToNearestHour
methods.description: Verifies that FloorToNearestHour correctly rounds timestamps to the nearest hour.

methods.name: TestTruncateText
methods.description: Tests the truncateText function for strings of various lengths, ensuring proper truncation and ellipsis addition.

methods.name: TestFirstNImages
methods.description: Tests the firstNImages function for different scenarios including empty slices, requesting more images than available, and negative request counts.

methods.name: TestTruncateOpenGraph
methods.description: Checks that TruncateOpenGraph correctly truncates text fields and limits images to 5, removing other types of data.

methods.name: TestTruncateOpenGraphFiltersSVGImages
methods.description: Ensures SVG images are filtered out during OpenGraph truncation.

methods.name: TestIsSVGImageURL
methods.description: Tests various URLs to determine if they are recognized as SVG images based on extension, case, and query parameters.

methods.name: TestFilterSVGImages
methods.description: Tests filtering of SVG images from a list based on URL, SecureURL, MIME type, and filename, including handling of nil entries.
